description: Price a list of things to buy in one call. Each item is matched to the closest product sharpest.ai tracks (computer parts, electronics, collectibles, household staples), and you get the cheapest current US eBay asking price (item + shipping) for each, times its quantity, and the list total. Use it for a PC build, a homelab or NAS parts list, a set of cards, or a grocery/household list. Check the matched name: when it is not what was meant, refine that query and call again.

items.description: The shopping list: up to 30 objects, each {"query": what to buy, optional "quantity"}, e.g. [{"query": "2TB NVMe", "quantity": 2}]

query.description: What to buy, e.g. 'RTX 4070 Super', '2TB NVMe', 'AA batteries'

name: price_shopping_list
